title: Studio Data › Actions: "Add field value" adds no row, so an update action's `patch` cannot be authored in Studio (the published action is a no-op)
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

The update-fields action can be created and published but never given any field to set from Studio.

## Reproduction

1. Data › Actions › an "Update fields" action › "Add field value" → no row appears (two sessions); draft stays `patch: {}`.
2. Published "Mark done" does nothing until `patch` is set through the API.

## Expected

The button adds an editable row held locally until a field is chosen, then commits.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` (~640-644 and ~831): `commitPatch([...patchRows, ["", ""]])` drops the empty key immediately.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured twice by the data gap-fill card.
- Business reason: One of the four presets ("change a picklist field") cannot be completed in Studio.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `update action Add field value button adds no row patch stays empty Studio action inspector` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 3 hits, all closed and about runtime semantics (#24268, #24394, #23427).
- QA id: G3
